paragraphs.source_en: As she passed through the massive, strongly fortified castle enclosures and proceeded as far as the steps of the inner quarters, Kina’s feet grew heavier and heavier. Naturally, she could not tell the two servants what she intended, so they felt neither anxiety nor fear; Kina’s own heart, however, was far from untroubled. The woman she was to kill was Ieyasu’s beloved concubine and carried his child. If Kina killed her, there was no possibility that she would leave the castle alive.
